schema_version.description: Manifest contract version. Missing means v1. v1 keeps runtime fields at top level; v2 moves runtime fields below providers.

name.description: profile id, matches repo suffix tack-<name>

permissions.description: settings.permissions deltas merged over the core baseline. Declaring defaultMode here makes it profile-owned: personal-overrides.json can no longer set it, so the authority the agent runs under is readable in git. Other permission keys (allow lists, per-machine grants) stay machine-local.

plugins.description: v1 Claude enabledPlugins deltas merged over the core baseline; v2 manifests use providers.claude.plugins

mcp.description: MCP servers this profile wants. Plugin-provided (context7, chrome-devtools, playwright) ride enabledPlugins. Explicitly added servers live in the MCP_TABLE in lib/apply-profile.sh: atlassian and scrapling. tokensave and sequential-thinking are always dropped (tokensave has a CLI; native reasoning covers sequential-thinking).

skills_link.description: skills symlinked from outside the harness; key is the skill name under ~/.claude/skills, value is the source path. Prefix with ~/ or $HARNESS_ROOT/ (the machine's repo dir, from ~/.claude/.harness-root) to keep a committed manifest portable; a bare absolute path is one machine's layout and will resolve nowhere else. Missing targets are skipped, not fatal.

skills_source.description: where a skills_link target comes from when it is missing; key is the skill name (must also appear in skills_link), value is the package the `skills` CLI knows it by, e.g. "vercel-labs/skills@find-skills". A package spec only, never a command: apply-profile drops it into a fixed argv (`skills add <spec> -g -y`) after a charset check, so a manifest can never run arbitrary code on a machine that syncs it. A skills_link entry with no source here is skipped exactly as before. Set HARNESS_NO_SKILL_INSTALL=1 to turn the installs off on one machine.

env.description: v1 Claude environment deltas; v2 manifests use providers.claude.env

skills.description: Shared skill names requested by this profile. Reserved for v2 adapter composition; core skills remain implicit during migration.

memory.description: Shared memory intent. Provider adapters decide installation and runtime-specific config.
